summary: The United States paused its nearly two-week daily strike campaign against Iran as President Trump opted for diplomatic space amid Omani mediation on the Strait of Hormuz, while Israeli forces eliminated three senior Hamas operatives in Gaza and West Bank tensions surged after a Palestinian gunman seized an Israeli's weapon near Susya. Explosions were reported in Iran's Bandar Abbas port, and Ukrainian strikes targeted Iranian-linked shipping in the Caspian Sea. Large smoke plumes appeared at Saudi Arabia's Jazan Refinery, and suspected vehicle-ramming and stabbing attacks occurred in the West Bank.
key_points: Trump halted U.S. strikes on Iran after 13 consecutive nights, citing Patriot battery shortages and ongoing Omani-brokered talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @New_security8200/202978)

IDF confirmed elimination of Hamas Nukhba commander Muhammad Abu Ghazal in central Gaza and two senior operatives — aerial observer Raed Amzi and military intelligence chief Nabhan Amzi — in northern Gaza. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93925)

Palestinian gunman seized an Israeli civilian's weapon near Susya in the southern West Bank, fired shots, and fled; IDF retrieved the weapon and launched a pursuit while Central Command barred all Palestinian workers from Israeli settlements. (Source: @idf_telegram/24719)

Multiple explosions heard in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province; Iranian state media acknowledged blasts amid heightened U.S.-Iran tensions and Ukrainian attacks on Iranian-linked Caspian Sea shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/8519)

Ukrainian forces claimed strikes on a Russian warship and Iranian-affiliated cargo vessels in the Caspian Sea; Iran condemned the attack on its commercial vessel and demanded UNSC action. (Source: @VahidOnline/77492)
Large smoke plumes observed at Saudi Aramco's Jazan Refinery in Jazan City; cause unconfirmed but coincides with regional escalation. (Source: @shin_persian/8518)
Suspected car-ramming attack at Highway 1 near Mitzpe Jericho wounded one; stabbing reported at Qalandia checkpoint under investigation. (Source: @pkpoi/143446)
Omani diplomatic delegation departed Tehran after talks on a new Strait of Hormuz arrangement; progress reported toward a possible weekend agreement. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380868)

Explosions were reported in Iran's Bandar Abbas port, and Ukrainian strikes targeted Iranian-linked shipping in the Caspian Sea. Large smoke plumes appeared at Saudi Arabia's Jazan Refinery, and suspected vehicle-ramming and stabbing attacks occurred in the West Bank.

points: President Trump ordered a halt to U.S. military strikes on Iran after 13 consecutive nights of attacks, citing a shortage of Patriot air-defense batteries and a desire to allow Omani-mediated diplomacy on a new Strait of Hormuz arrangement to progress. (Source: @New_security8200/202978, @Faytuks_Network/5736)

An Omani diplomatic delegation visited Tehran for talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz; sources indicate progress and a possible agreement by weekend, after which Trump would decide whether to accept the arrangement. (Source: @New_security8200/202978, @rasedal3ado138e/380868)
Two explosions were heard in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, at 2057Z; Iranian state media later confirmed blasts in the area amid heightened tensions. (Source: @shin_persian/8519, @N12chat/219145)
IRGC spokesman warned that if the United Kingdom supports U.S. attacks on Iran, it will become a legitimate target for Iranian forces. (Source: @asafroz/51896)

U.S. intelligence agencies assess that Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the supreme leader, is more determined to pursue nuclear weapons than his father, reflecting a hardening stance within Iran's leadership. (Source: @pkpoi/143435)

Trump stated he is "absolutely" considering resuming full-scale war against Iran if negotiations fail to yield 100% of U.S. demands, but also acknowledged ongoing talks with Tehran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5729, @amitsegal/63364)
Analysts suggest Iran has degraded a significant portion of Gulf air-defense arrays, contributing to Trump's reluctance to escalate immediately. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93931)

IDF announced the elimination of three senior Hamas operatives: Nukhba commander Muhammad As'ad Mahmoud Abu Ghazal in central Gaza (Monday), aerial observation operative Raed Hani Muhammad Amzi and military intelligence department head Nabhan Muhammad Nabhan Amzi in northern Gaza (Tuesday). (Source: @lelotsenzura/93925)

Central Command chief banned entry of all Palestinian workers to Israeli settlements in the West Bank following the fatal shooting near Gilad Farm that killed Maj. Yovel Ezra and Binyahu Maltz. (Source: @N12chat/219144, @yediotnews25/133185)

IDF conducted a large-scale arrest operation in the village of Tel near Nablus, interrogating dozens and arresting several suspects involved in the violent clash that preceded the Gilad Farm attack; forces raided the home of shooter Farouk Ramadan and began mapping for sealing and demolition. (Source: @New_security8200/202965)
Over 70 wanted Palestinians were arrested and hundreds investigated across the West Bank in a 24-hour counterterrorism surge. (Source: @idf_telegram/24717)

A Palestinian gunman seized an Israeli civilian's weapon near Susya in the southern Hebron Hills, fired shots, and fled toward Yatta; the civilian was lightly injured by stone-throwing; IDF retrieved the weapon and established roadblocks in pursuit. (Source: @idf_telegram/24719, @manniefabian/58852)

A civilian drone fell near National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's residence in Hebron; authorities stated no terror link and investigation is ongoing. (Source: @amitsegal/63370, @lelotsenzura/93928, @kianmeli1/90073)

Suspected car-ramming attack at Highway 1 near Mitzpe Jericho junction left one person wounded; a stabbing incident was reported at Qalandia checkpoint and is under examination. (Source: @pkpoi/143446, @rasedal3ado138e/380904)

Palestinian sources reported the killing of the Northern District Police commander in Gaza; four separate strikes hit different locations in the Strip starting at 12:00. (Source: @yediotnews25/133175)
Artillery shelling targeted eastern areas of the Gaza Strip. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380871)
Israeli forces continue to hold 40 Palestinian journalists, including five women, in Damon prison under reportedly severe humanitarian and health conditions. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380888)

In the South Hebron Hills near Susya, Palestinians seized a Jewish farm owner's weapon, shot at him, and fled to Yatta; IDF recovered the weapon and is pursuing the assailant. (Source: @yediotnews25/133185)
IDF reinforced troops in Judea and Samaria after the Gilad Farm shooting; the gunmen were later eliminated in a Nablus operation. (Source: @yediotnews25/133185)
Documented strike near Al-Aqsa Hospital in Gaza. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93919)
An Israeli vehicle entering the Eshkol settlement gate was misidentified as Palestinian, triggering a brief alert; no anomaly found. (Source: @inon_yttach/9664)

Lebanese internal security alert system (RedAlertLB) issued a call for immediate reporting of any hostile aerial or military activity via dedicated bots, indicating heightened border vigilance. (Source: @redlinkleb/32996)
An Israeli military patrol infiltrated the Al-Ma'kar area west of Said Al-Hanout village in the Quneitra countryside, southern Syria. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380902)
Multiple large smoke plumes were observed emanating from the Saudi Aramco Jazan Refinery in Jazan City (coordinates 17.323835, 42.404570); cause unconfirmed. (Source: @shin_persian/8518)
Clashes erupted between Yemeni forces and Saudi-affiliated militias in Al-Jawf governorate, northern Yemen. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85601)

Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi spoke with EU Vice-President Kallas, condemning the Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea and demanding a firm UNSC and EU response; both sides discussed Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz tensions. (Source: @presstv/200344)
Trump warned Russia and China that selling weapons to Iran would be "very bad" for them. (Source: @yediotnews25/133185)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous pause in U.S. strikes on Iran and elimination of senior Hamas commanders in Gaza reflects a calibrated Israeli-U.S. effort to manage escalation while degrading Iranian and proxy capabilities. However, the West Bank is nearing a flashpoint: the Susya weapon seizure, settlement worker ban, and mass arrests indicate a widening security crackdown that could ignite broader confrontation. Iran's reported explosions at Bandar Abbas and the Caspian Sea incidents suggest its supply lines and coastal infrastructure are under novel pressure from Ukrainian action, potentially complicating Tehran's regional logistics. The Jazan Refinery smoke plumes, if confirmed as an attack, would signal a dangerous expansion of targeting to Saudi energy infrastructure. The Omani diplomatic track remains the primary off-ramp for U.S.-Iran tensions, but Trump's threat to resume "full-scale war" if talks fail keeps military options live.
sections.regional_response: Oman's active mediation on the Strait of Hormuz has yielded a potential agreement that could ease maritime tensions, but its success hinges on Trump's acceptance. The EU, via Kallas, engaged Iran diplomatically after the Caspian Sea incident, though concrete action remains unlikely. Saudi Arabia has not officially commented on the Jazan Refinery plumes, suggesting caution to avoid escalation. The Palestinian Authority has not been mentioned in the messages, but the detention of 40 journalists and the settlement worker ban will likely draw condemnation from Arab states and international bodies.
